messages:
maria: quick note  we're seeing different error shapes across SDKs during onboarding tests. py raises AuthExpired, go returns raw 401 text, js returns nested object with varying keys. makes retry/UX handling fragile. can we land a tiny canonical error JSON and language-idiomatic typed exceptions that wrap it?

alex: yes. runtime emits canonical JSON, SDKs map to native exceptions and expose the raw body. keeps both worlds.

sam: propose minimal canonical fields: type, status, message, error_class, retryable, retry_after_seconds, hint_code, documentation_url. small and actionable.

linda: agree. suggest error_class values: auth, permission, rate_limit, user_input, not_found, conflict, transient_server.

maria: also differentiate user-facing copy vs dev logs. UI: "Session expired  please sign in." Dev log: "AuthError: token expired (401)".

alex: streaming note: mid-stream errors include same fields + optional stream_resume_token. SDKs should surface a StreamError with resume metadata.

ci-bot: test idea: matrix that posts canonical payloads to runtime and asserts each SDK surfaces matching error_class and retryable. add to nightly.

maria: example we can paste in SDK READMEs: 

```json
{
  "type": "RateLimitError",
  "status": 429,
  "message": "Too many requests",
  "error_class": "rate_limit",
  "retryable": true,
  "retry_after_seconds": 30,
  "hint_code": "reduce_concurrency",
  "documentation_url": "https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate-limit"
}
```

linda: nice. also include `hint_code` values like `refresh_token`, `backoff`, `contact_support` so UIs can pick actions.

sam: runtime mapping draft: 400 -> user_input (retryable=false); 401/403 -> auth/permission (retryable=false); 404 -> not_found; 409 -> conflict; 429 -> rate_limit (retryable=true); 5xx -> transient_server (retryable=true). populate retry_after_seconds from Retry-After when present.

alex: SDK ergonomics: each SDK should expose a typed exception class (e.g., RateLimitError) with properties: status, raw_error (dict/object/string), and is_retryable bool. keep names idiomatic per language.

maria: next steps: i'll draft RFC + sample patches for py/go/js and a docs page. volunteers? @alex (go/java), @linda (js/docs), @sam (runtime tests).

alex: i'll take go changes.

linda: i'll do js and docs.

sam: i'll add integration tests and CI gating.

maria: i'll open tracking ticket DX-ER-2031 and link RFC. thanks! :rocket:

jira-bot: Created ticket DX-ER-2031: "Canonical error JSON + typed SDK exceptions" assigned to maria, alex, linda, sam.
